<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="חשון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915018_theRebbe_923" batchId="meluket-_D7_97_D7_A9_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915018_theRebbe_923__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Avraham attained the level of "all" through ten trials, teaching that divine service requires extraordinary effort, which brings the revelation of the hidden essential self.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, that which is related in the Oral Torah, that Avraham merited the aspect of "all" by standing in ten trials, is</t>
    <t s="2">(like all matters in Torah, from the word "hora'ah" [teaching]60)</t>
    <t s="3">a teaching that it must be</t>
    <t s="4">(similar to61)</t>
    <t s="5">the service of trials,</t>
    <t s="6">namely,</t>
    <t s="7">that the service must be with great effort,</t>
    <t s="8">effort that is not in the ordinary way,</t>
    <t s="9">similar to the service of trials.</t>
    <t s="10">And this is what is stated in the Zohar there on the verse62</t>
    <t s="11">"No eye has seen, etc., He will do for those who wait for Him,"</t>
    <t s="12">"What is 'for those who wait for Him'? ... Those who press into the word of wisdom, etc."</t>
    <t s="13">[And this matter in the Zohar comes in continuation of the explanation of "what is 'all',"</t>
    <t s="14">as brought in the maamar],</t>
    <t s="15">that through effort in Torah,</t>
    <t s="16">effort that is not in the ordinary way</t>
    <t s="17">[and as explained in the maamar, "those who press into the word of wisdom" is effort in the manner of Or Chozer (returning light)],</t>
    <t s="18">and from this it follows that also the fulfillment of the mitzvos will be with great effort</t>
    <t s="19">(in the manner of our sages' statement63</t>
    <t s="20">"Great is study that brings to action"),</t>
    <t s="21">including also the effort in spreading the wellsprings outward,</t>
    <t s="22">for in addition to the effort that must be in the study and understanding of the wellsprings</t>
    <t s="23">("pressing into the word of wisdom"),</t>
    <t s="24">there must be a special effort to spread the wellsprings outward,</t>
    <t s="25">to bring the wellsprings also to those who are outside,</t>
    <t s="26">"among the thorns,"</t>
    <t s="27">and through this "the Master, King Moshiach, will come"64,</t>
    <t s="28">for then there will be the revelation of the hidden essential self (Atzmus),</t>
    <t s="29">"No eye has seen,"</t>
    <t s="30">speedily in our days, literally.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
